preferredPlatform.title: Preferred platform
preferredPlatform.description: Files for this platform are listed first. Other platforms stay in the list.

skipSoundtracksAndExtras.title: Skip soundtracks and extras
skipSoundtracksAndExtras.description: Hide files whose name says soundtrack or OST.

syncOwnedGames.title: Import owned games
syncOwnedGames.description: Import the games in your itch.io library. Turn off to import nothing.

syncIntervalHours.title: Library cache (hours)
syncIntervalHours.description: Reuse the last library import for this many hours. 0 always re-imports.

updateCheckIntervalHours.title: Update check interval (hours)
updateCheckIntervalHours.description: Skip a game's update check if it was checked this recently. 0 always checks.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Wait this long between requests to itch.io. 0 sends them without a wait.

userAgent.title: User agent
userAgent.description: Browser identity sent with requests. Leave empty for the default.

verboseLogging.title: Verbose logging
verboseLogging.description: Write debug messages to the log.

dumpDir.title: Dump folder
dumpDir.description: Save raw pages here when a page cannot be read. Leave empty to save nothing.
